welcome.title: Hi! I'm Wonder
welcome.text: I'm here to help you discover stories about art, science, and culture through conversation.

welcome.title: Connect to the public WiFi
welcome.text: Internet connectivity is essential to maintain an uninterrupted conversation.

welcome.title: Slip on your headphones
welcome.text: We don't want to make it noisy for others.

welcome.title: Press and talk
welcome.text: Press the button to talk and ask questions about where you are and what you are curious about.

welcome.title: Start by asking
welcome.text: Where you are. The name of the art piece. Anything you want to know about it. Switch language on the go.
